evidence.note: TPS25750 is WQFN-42; FUSB302B is WLCSP-9 / MLP-14. Different package and pin count.
Different pinout — TPS25750 includes integrated power path switches (PP1/PP2) that FUSB302B does not have.
TPS25750 handles VBUS up to 22V and gates the path; FUSB302B only senses VBUS up to 30V.
TPS25750 is a full PD controller with policy engine; FUSB302B is a PD PHY only and requires an external EC running the policy engine. The two are not interchangeable roles.

verification_notes: Different functional role: TPS25750 is a full PD controller; FUSB302B is a PHY only. They are NOT interchangeable even on identical boards.
